verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents persistent browser sessions in which cookies, local storage, open tabs and the current page carry over, so later operations resume where the previous one stopped without losing browser state (skyvern-docs-21, skyvern-docs-10). That covers persisting logged-in state within a session, but nothing shows named, reusable profiles that survive across separate future runs. Stored credentials and 2FA handling automate the login itself rather than skipping it, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented reusable browser profiles that persist auth state across independent runs, session lifetime/expiry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
